en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a lively park scene with many people strolling and socializing near a tall, octagonal tower with a domed roof and lantern. Leafy trees surround a wide lawn in the foreground where a child sits, while crowds with early 20th‑century clothing gather on the paths near the tower. At the top in red German text it identifies the location in Graz and names the site with its bell tower.
